title: POV: it's 11pm and you're still answering "u got anything tmrw?"
description:
if your bookings live in your DMs, you're on call until you fall asleep. a booking page in your bio lets clients pick a free time themselves, get a reminder email before they come, and cancel with a link instead of texting you.

MyHour is €9/month after a 14-day free trial (no card needed to start), and it never takes a commission on bookings. myhourapp.com
